notes: Capability Registry — declaration + health + recorded on/off intent. This file is read by `workbench capability` CLI only; it is NEVER injected into model context. External capabilities are never auto-installed; inspect prints manual steps.

capabilities.name: Failure-memory oracle
capabilities.cost_hint: zero resident; per-query CLI call only
capabilities.trigger: fail-triggered only (query before debugging an actual failure; never by default on a fresh task)
capabilities.security: local JSONL only; no network; project-isolated
capabilities.wiring: active (fail-triggered policy in workbench CLAUDE.md + failure-oracle skill)
capabilities.evidence: mechanism contract-verified; in-vivo retrieval benefit UNPROVEN (honest-null x3, see docs/POLICY_VERIFICATION.md)

capabilities.name: Three-tier irreversible-command gate

capabilities.evidence: 42 contracts incl. fail-closed; --print sessions do not execute hooks (disclosed)
